turns.question: What revenue did customers who signed up in August or September 2024 bring in on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: Customers who signed up in August 2024 brought in EUR 12.00 and those who signed up in September 2024 brought in EUR 300.00 of revenue on 1 October 2026 (revenue by signup-month cohort, non-cancelled orders; the semantic layer returned the two cohorts separately).
